rust: Arena empty slice: bumpalo Vec::new_in(arena).into_bump_slice() not &[] (UAF risk)
Benchmark ROI automation via bench_roi_report binary that runs benches, parses criterion estimates.json, and emits docs/benchmarks report artifacts
CoreEngine trait in core, transport crates are thin adapters
Deterministic sort by URI then range for stable output
Drop read lock before async calls (deadlock prevention)
Local security guardrail uses lefthook pre-commit with strict ordering before commit
Range containment for nested XML document symbols
Security scans run advisory-only during initial adoption (continue-on-error in CI jobs)
Single-pass stack tokenizer for XML extraction
Tier benchmark controls via MARKYMARK_BENCH_SAMPLES and MARKYMARK_BENCH_DOC_TIER to separate quick iteration from scale validation
Use arena_ref() helper to avoid duplicated unsafe transmute logic
extract_list_items returns Vec<&ListItem> (refs not clones) to avoid ArenaHashMap::clone SIGSEGV
codeStyle.bash: set -euo pipefail, jq for JSON, case statements for file extension matching

codePatterns: DocumentArena wrapper preferred over raw Bump for per-document arenas (Debug, capacity)
ArenaHashMap is !Send (Bump:!Sync); parser types can use it, index types must use std HashMap
Self-referential arena: struct owns Bump + stores refs as static; doc_arena_ptr() for ownership transfer
